topsink_null_guard.patch and bottom_sink_nonuniform.patch are modifications of the 3D-ICE 4.0 C sources
(https://github.com/esl-epfl/3d-ice, Copyright (C) Embedded Systems Laboratory, EPFL; GPL-3.0-or-later) and are
derivative works of them. asan_backtrace.txt quotes lines of those sources. issue3/mem_mat.flp and the .stk/.flp
files in issue3/ and matrix/ were rebuilt from 3D-ICE's example files (example_steady_material.stk, mem_mat.flp).
Everything in this directory is therefore distributed under the GNU General Public License, version 3 or (at your
option) any later version; the full text is in LICENSE-GPL-3.0 in this directory.

They are NOT covered by the MIT licence of the rest of iceforge (tools/iceforge/LICENSE), and they are
not part of the iceforge wheel (only the `iceforge` package is packaged).
